jobDetails.title: Senior AWS Connect Developer
jobDetails.description:
Gainwell Technologies LLC

Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven Senior AWS Connect Developer with strong expertise in contact center technologies, customer service platforms, and Amazon Connect. This role requires a hands-on technical professional who can translate business requirements into scalable contact center solutions, integrate Amazon Connect with CRM and enterprise applications, and support production environments. The ideal candidate brings strong AWS knowledge, troubleshooting skills, stakeholder management, and experience collaborating with onshore and offshore teams, preferably within the healthcare domain. This role is strictly involved in the development of the product and does not involve access to Protected Health Information (PHI) & Personally Identifiable Information (PII) or any secured/confidential client data. The work is limited to application development and does not include handling or processing of sensitive health information.

Your role in our mission

As a AWS Connect Developer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, integrating, and supporting customer contact solutions that improve operational efficiency and customer experience. You will:

  • Design, develop, and enhance Amazon Connect solutions for voice and digital customer interactions
  • Configure and optimize call routing, IVR, queues, and contact flows based on business requirements
  • Enable omnichannel interactions across voice, chat, email, and SMS
  • Integrate Amazon Connect with CRM platforms and other enterprise applications
  • Develop and support integrations using AWS services such as Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, and IAM
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues and identify sustainable improvements
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and onshore and offshore delivery teams to ensure successful implementation
  • Support technical documentation, testing, deployment, and release readiness
  • Provide technical guidance and communicate solution options, risks, and dependencies clearly
What we're looking for

We are looking for a candidate who brings a strong combination of contact center expertise, AWS technical skills, problem-solving ability, and leadership:

Experience:

•  10+ years of experience in contact center technologies or customer service platforms

•  2-3+ years of hands-on experience with Amazon Connect

Contact Center & Integration Expertise:

•  Good understanding of call routing, IVR, queues, and omnichannel interactions across voice, chat, email, and SMS

•  Experience integrating Amazon Connect with CRM and other enterprise applications

•  Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions

•  Healthcare domain knowledge is preferred

Technical & Cloud Skills:

•  Knowledge of AWS services such as Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, and IAM

•  Experience in troubleshooting and resolving production issues

Leadership & Soft Skills:

•  Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

•  Ability to work collaboratively with onshore and offshore teams

•  Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and delivery ownership

Certifications (Preferred):

•  Amazon Connect and/or AWS Cloud certifications are preferred

What you should expect in this role
  • Remote working environment
  • Shift time -2pm - 11PM IST

 Senior AWS Connect Developer
